children.name: Evidence
children.value: The blocks hold a new config block, which WavPack 5.0 added; libwavpack reports encoder version 5 for a file with one

findings.message: The first block says the file holds 24000 samples, but its audio blocks hold 17513.
The block at 0x34BA begins at sample 17512, but the block before it ends at sample 11025: 6487 samples are missing.
